title: Pan-Seared Binchotan Steak with Slovakian Hash
description: A classic Italian-inspired dish featuring a tender Binchotan steak served with a crispy Slovakian hash. Perfect for a hearty dinner.
instructions: Season the Binchotan steaks with salt and black pepper.
Grill the steaks for 4-5 minutes per side, or until they reach your desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the Slovakian hash to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes, until crispy and golden brown.
Serve the grilled Binchotan steaks with the Slovakian hash and garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
Cook the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a pan over low heat.
Add a small amount of hash to the pan and fry until crispy, breaking it up with a spatula as it cooks.
Repeat the process until all of the hash is crispy and golden brown.
